# PLS-DA Evaluation
## Set up the data for analysis
```{r}
## Import all results
initial_data <- list(
    "all_binary_don" = read.csv("results/mixed_all/plsda_1000_all.csv"),
    "all_binary_total_don" = read.csv("results/mixed_all/plsda_total_don_all.csv"),
    "all_weighted_don" = read.csv("results/mixed_all/weighted_plsda_1000_all.csv"),
    "all_weighted_total_don" = read.csv("results/mixed_all/weighted_plsda_total_don_all.csv"),
    "austrian_binary_don" = read.csv("results/austrian/plsda_1000_all.csv"),
    "austrian_binary_total_don" = read.csv("results/austrian/plsda_total_don_all.csv"),
    "austrian_weighted_don" = read.csv("results/austrian/weighted_plsda_1000_all.csv"),
    "austrian_weighted_total_don" = read.csv("results/austrian/weighted_plsda_total_don_all.csv")
)

# remove all column except 1 - 5 and 15
data <- lapply(initial_data, function(df) df[, c(1:6, 11:14, 18,19)])

# add details about the sample_weight
data <- Map(function(df, nm) {
  df$Sample_weight <- if (grepl("weighted", nm, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    "Weighted"
  } else {
    "None"
  }
  df
}, data, names(data))

## add details about the dataset
data <- Map(function(df, nm) {
  df$Dataset <- if (grepl("austrian", nm, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
    "Austrian"
  } else {
    "All"
  }
  df
}, data, names(data))

# combine all dataframes into one
combined_data <- do.call(rbind, data)

# Add TPR and TNR
combined_data$TPR <- combined_data$TP / (combined_data$TP + combined_data$FN)
combined_data$TNR <- combined_data$TN / (combined_data$TN + combined_data$FP)

#rename the columns and dataframe for better readability
library(dplyr)
lme_data <- combined_data %>%
 rename(
   Grinding = Sample_source,
   Toxin = Target_toxin,
   Weighting = Sample_weight,
   Downsampling = Downsampled
 ) %>%
  mutate(
    Grinding = case_when(
      Grinding == "intact" ~ "None",
      Grinding == "ground" ~ "Ground",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Grinding)
    ),
    Toxin = case_when(
      Toxin == "Total_DON" ~ "Total DON",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Toxin)
    ),
    Preprocessing = case_when(
      Preprocessing == "1st_Der" ~ "FD",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Preprocessing)
    ),
    Downsampling = case_when(
      Downsampling %in% c("TRUE", TRUE) ~ "Downsampled",
      Downsampling %in% c("FALSE", FALSE) ~ "None",
      TRUE ~ as.character(Downsampling)
    )
  )

# except F1_Score, TPR, TNR and MCC, transform all to factor
lme_data[c(1:6, 13,14)] <- lapply(lme_data[c(1:6, 13,14)], as.factor)
write.csv(lme_data, "results/lme_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Analysis using Linear mixed-effects on F1-Score
This experiment is performed using Full Factorial Design with 6 factors: Grinding, Toxin, Preprocessing, Variable_Selection, Downsampling, Dataset and Weighting. The model includes all main effects and interactions up to the three-way level. The random effect is Split, which accounts for the variability across different data splits.

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(glmmTMB)
library(car)
library(emmeans)

# The F1_Score is a proportion, so we can use a beta regression with logit link function. However, since we have random effects, we will use glmmTMB which can handle beta regression with random effects.
model_f1 <- glmmTMB(F1_score ~ Dataset + Downsampling + Grinding + Toxin + Weighting + Preprocessing + Variable_Selection + (1|Split), data = lme_data, 
family = ordbeta(link = "logit"), control = glmmTMBControl(optCtrl = list(iter.max = 1000, eval.max = 1000)))

Anova(model_f1, type = "II") # All main effects are significant.
summary(model_f1)

# Get marginal means for all combinations
pipeline_means_f1 <- emmeans(model_f1, 
                          ~ Grinding * Toxin * Preprocessing * 
                            Variable_Selection * Downsampling * 
                            Dataset * Weighting)

# Convert to dataframe and back-transform to probability scale
pipeline_df_f1 <- as.data.frame(pipeline_means_f1) %>%
  mutate(
    pipeline = paste(Grinding, Toxin, Preprocessing,
                     Variable_Selection, Downsampling,
                     Dataset, Weighting, sep = " | "),
    F1_est   = plogis(emmean),
    F1_lcl   = plogis(asymp.LCL),
    F1_ucl   = plogis(asymp.UCL)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(F1_est))

```

### Model Validation

```{r}
library(performance)
library(see)
library(ggplot2)
icc(model_f1)
r2(model_f1) #explain 87.8% of the variance in F1 score
check_collinearity(model_f1) # there is no collinearity issue in the model
pp_check <- check_predictions(model_f1)
pp <- plot(pp_check) + theme_classic()
pp
ggsave("./figures/PLS_DA/f1_prediction_check.svg", pp, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300) # prediction fit well with the observed data
```

## Analysis using Linear mixed-effects on TPR
 
 ```{r}
library(glmmTMB)
library(car)
library(emmeans) 
# Data analysis for TPR
model_tpr <- glmmTMB(TPR ~ Grinding + Toxin + Preprocessing + Variable_Selection + Downsampling + Dataset + Weighting + (1|Split), data = lme_data, family = ordbeta(link = "logit"),
control = glmmTMBControl(optCtrl = list(iter.max = 1000, eval.max = 1000)))
Anova(model_tpr, type = "II")
summary(model_tpr)

```

### FP and FN analysis for the most optimal pipeline

```{r}
# import the csv files
# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)

# Load the data
results_f1 <- list(
  none = read.csv("./results/F1/plsda_1000_all.csv"),
  weighted = read.csv("./results/F1/weighted_plsda_1000_all.csv"))

# Extract and separate the FP and FN samples into a long format
missclassified_samples <- lapply(results_f1, function(df) {
  fp_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(Split, FP_Samples) %>%
    filter(FP_Samples != "", !is.na(FP_Samples)) %>%
    separate_rows(FP_Samples, sep = ";\\s*") %>%
    rename(Sample_ID = FP_Samples) %>%
    mutate(Misclassification = "False Positive (FP)")
  
  fn_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(Split, FN_Samples) %>%
    filter(FN_Samples != "", !is.na(FN_Samples)) %>%
    separate_rows(FN_Samples, sep = ";\\s*") %>%
    rename(Sample_ID = FN_Samples) %>%
    mutate(Misclassification = "False Negative (FN)")
  
  bind_rows(fp_df, fn_df)
})

y <- read_excel("data/nirs_intact.xlsx") %>% dplyr::select(c("Sample_ID", "Total DON"))
missclassified_samples <- lapply(missclassified_samples, function(df) {
  df %>%
    inner_join(y, by = "Sample_ID") %>%
    mutate(
      Uncertainty = case_when(
        `Total DON` < 700 ~ "False Positive (FP)",
        `Total DON` > 1300 ~ "False Negative (FN)",
        `Total DON` < 1000 ~ "Uncertain False Positive (UFP)",
        TRUE ~ "Uncertain False Negative (UFN)"
      ),
      Uncertainty = factor(Uncertainty, levels = c("False Positive (FP)", "Uncertain False Positive (UFP)", "Uncertain False Negative (UFN)", "False Negative (FN)"))
    )
})

sum(missclassified_samples$none$Misclassification == "False Negative (FN)") + sum(missclassified_samples$none$Uncertainty == "False Positive (FP)")
sum(missclassified_samples$weighted$Misclassification == "False Negative (FN)") + sum(missclassified_samples$weighted$Uncertainty == "False Positive (FP)")
str(missclassified_samples)
# 4. Create a histogram plot
source("./utils/plotting.R")
missclassified_plot <- lapply(missclassified_samples, function(df){
  return(hist_plot(df))
})
missclassified_plot$none
missclassified_plot$weighted

df_combined <- bind_rows(
  missclassified_samples$none %>% mutate(Weighting = "False"),
  missclassified_samples$weighted %>% mutate(Weighting = "True")
)

# Create the grouped bar chart
ggplot(df_combined, aes(x = Misclassification, fill = Weighting)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("False" = "#88CCEE", "True" = "#CC6677")) +
  labs(title = "How Weighting Shifts Misclassification Types",
       x = "Type of Misclassification",
       y = "Number of Samples") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# Plotting the density of Total DON for FP and FN samples
library(ggplot2)
max_density <- max(density(df_combined$`Total DON`, na.rm = TRUE)$y)
y_pos <- max_density + 0.0002

error_density <- ggplot(df_combined, aes(x = `Total DON`, fill = Weighting)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.3) +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("False" = "#FFC20A", "True" = "#0C7BDC"), 
    labels = c("False" = "Non-weighted (Pipeline 2)", "True" = "Weighted (Pipeline 1)")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Total DON (µg/kg)",
    y = " Error Density"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.title = element_blank()
  ) +
  
  # Add the vertical line at exactly 1000
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1000, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  
  # Add "False Negative" (Left side of 1000)
  annotate("text", x = 950, y = y_pos, label = "False Positive", hjust = 1, fontface = "bold") +
  # Add a horizontal line segment under/near the text
  annotate("segment", x = 950, xend = 500, y = y_pos - (y_pos * 0.05), yend = y_pos - (y_pos * 0.05), 
           arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm"))) +
  
  # Add "False Positive" (Right side of 1000) 
  annotate("text", x = 1050, y = y_pos, label = "False Negative", hjust = 0, fontface = "bold") +
  # Add a horizontal line segment under/near the text
  annotate("segment", x = 1050, xend = 1500, y = y_pos - (y_pos * 0.05), yend = y_pos - (y_pos * 0.05), 
           arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")))

error_density
ggsave("./figures/PLS_DA/misclassification_density_plot.svg", error_density, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

## Effect of DON and Total DON

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(readxl)
# Load all data
results_don <- list(
  don = read.csv("./results/F1/DON_Total_DON/DON.csv"),
  total_don = read.csv("./results/F1/DON_Total_DON/Total_DON.csv"))

# Extract and separate the FP and FN samples into a long format
missclassified_don <- lapply(results_don, function(df) {
  fp_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(Split, FP_Samples) %>%
    filter(FP_Samples != "", !is.na(FP_Samples)) %>%
    separate_rows(FP_Samples, sep = ";\\s*") %>%
    rename(Sample_ID = FP_Samples) %>%
    mutate(Misclassification = "False Positive (FP)")
  
  fn_df <- df %>%
    dplyr::select(Split, FN_Samples) %>%
    filter(FN_Samples != "", !is.na(FN_Samples)) %>%
    separate_rows(FN_Samples, sep = ";\\s*") %>%
    rename(Sample_ID = FN_Samples) %>%
    mutate(Misclassification = "False Negative (FN)")
  
  bind_rows(fp_df, fn_df)
})

y_total_don <- read_excel("data/nirs_intact.xlsx") %>% dplyr::select(c("Sample_ID", "Total DON"))
y_don <- read_excel("data/nirs_intact.xlsx") %>% dplyr::select(c("Sample_ID", "Deoxynivalenol"))
missclassified_don$don <- missclassified_don$don %>%
  inner_join(y_don, by = "Sample_ID")
missclassified_don$total_don <- missclassified_don$total_don %>%
  inner_join(y_total_don, by = "Sample_ID")

#change the name of the column "Deoxynivalenol" to Toxin concentration
colnames(missclassified_don$don)[colnames(missclassified_don$don) == "Deoxynivalenol"] <- "Toxin_concentration"
colnames(missclassified_don$total_don)[colnames(missclassified_don$total_don) == "Total DON"] <- "Toxin_concentration"

df_combined_don <- bind_rows(
  missclassified_don$don %>% mutate(Toxin = "DON"),
  missclassified_don$total_don %>% mutate(Toxin = "Total_DON")
)

# Create the grouped bar chart
ggplot(df_combined_don, aes(x = Misclassification, fill = Toxin)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("DON" = "#88CCEE", "Total_DON" = "#CC6677")) +
  labs(title = "How Weighting Shifts Misclassification Types",
       x = "Type of Misclassification",
       y = "Number of Samples") +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

# Create the overlapping density plot
error_density_don <- ggplot(df_combined_don, aes(x = Toxin_concentration, fill = Toxin)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  theme_classic() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1000, linetype = "dashed", color = "black", linewidth = 1) + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("DON" = "#FFC20A", "Total_DON" = "#0C7BDC")) +
  labs(x = "Toxin concentration (µg/kg)",
       y = "Density") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 6000, by = 500)) +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())
error_density_don
ggsave("./figures/PLS_DA/misclassification_density_plot.svg", error_density_don, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
